empty.title: You're early. That's the point.
empty.body: We're building this community one verified Tricity family at a time, so there isn't much here yet. Sharpen your preferences so we match you well from the first profile, and invite someone you'd trust with an introduction.

upgradeModal.description: See who's viewing your profile and show your interest

photo.title: Add a photo to your profile
photo.body: Families look for a photograph first. Without one your profile shows below everyone else in search, and most people will scroll past it.
photo.note: You can hide your photos from anyone you have not matched with in Settings → Privacy.

verify.title: Get your profile verified
verify.body: A live selfie, checked by our team against your photos. Verified profiles carry a badge, rank higher in search, and are the ones families take seriously.
verify.note: Takes about a minute. The selfie is never shown on your profile.
